highlights:
# Calyb AI

Calyb AI is a Software Development company. Calyb AI employs 8 people (+166.7% YoY, +5 people), founded in 2025. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across India and United States.

## About

Calyb adds Intelligence to your SaaS and Enterprise Softwares. In a Day. 

Using Calyb you can deploy AI workers natively in your product ecosystem- all trained on your workflows, domain and tribal knowledge and data streams. 

Just state your use case and it gets added instantly. No more plumbing to add intelligent workflows and features in your product. 

Build AI workers to automate and build autonomous version of your software-

...

payload.summary: Calyb AI is a San Francisco-based AI software startup (founded 2025) that helps SaaS and enterprise products add intelligent, autonomous AI “workers” trained on a company’s workflows and data. The solution enables quick deployment of AI features within existing product ecosystems—no extensive integration required—by describing your use case and instantly creating AI-enabled capabilities. The company is privately held with a distributed team across the U.S. and India and maintains a presence at calyb.ai.
